about.title: About
about.p2: After four years designing and deploying web applications as a developer, in equipment services and sustainable engineering, I am now available for freelance work under the Consaltia brand.
about.p3: Over those years I covered the whole chain: API and microservice design, backend and frontend development, database modelling, CI/CD pipelines, containerisation and cloud deployment on AWS and Azure. I worked in Agile teams, led code reviews, mentored junior developers and shipped to production in demanding, regulated environments.
about.p4: Today, I put that experience directly to work on your projects: one point of contact, end to end.
proj.title: Selected work
proj.subtitle: Eleven projects detailed here, out of twenty delivered: web platforms, business applications, data and AI.
proj.cta: See the eleven documented projects in detail: context, constraints and solution
proj.note: Illustrative interfaces, recreated for this presentation. They are not screenshots of the final deliverables. Demos and technical details on request.
p1.title: Real-time delivery tracking
p1.desc: Giving dispatchers and customers a single view of the run: courier position on the map, route, order status, estimated time of arrival and recipient details, all updated live.
p2.title: Dating platform
p2.desc: Browsing profiles, managing matches and chatting in one place: featured profile, compatibility score, nearby suggestions, recent matches and built-in messaging.
p3.title: Car rental
p3.desc: Booking a vehicle in a few clicks: search by location and dates, comparison of available models, availability calendar and a price summary before confirming.
p4.title: Online store
p4.desc: Browsing a catalogue and preparing a purchase without friction: category navigation, filters, prices and availability readable at a glance on an uncluttered product grid.
p5.title: CarryLB: travellers & senders
p5.desc: Connecting travellers with spare luggage capacity to people sending a parcel: search by route and dates, recommended travellers, mapped itinerary and a price and weight summary before booking.
p6.title: Database migration
p6.desc: Driving and supervising a migration between two databases: pipeline progress, performance, validation checks and alerts, through to cut-over with no service interruption.
p7.title: AI document assistant
p7.desc: Querying a document base in natural language: cross-analysis of several sources, contextualised answers, key indicators and systematic citation of the documents used.
p8.title: Bar: storefront & ordering
p8.desc: Showcasing a bar's menu and making the offer easy to discover: featured cocktail, upmarket identity, a clear promise and calls to action towards booking or ordering.
p9.title: Project management
p9.desc: Giving teams a clear view of progress: work planning, task tracking on a Kanban board, deadlines on a timeline and milestones shared across everyone involved.
p10.title: Assets & contracts
p10.desc: Tracking hardware and software assets along with their contracts: asset register, due dates and renewals, early alerts and cost indicators.
p11.title: Quotes, pricing & invoicing
p11.desc: Pricing a job then invoicing it without re-keying: quote settings, editable line items, automatic subtotal, VAT and gross total, then conversion of the quote into an invoice.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: What clients ask before we start.
faq1.a: On the application side: React, Next.js, Angular, Node.js and Java / Spring Boot, with REST or GraphQL APIs and PostgreSQL. On the operations side: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitLab CI or GitHub Actions pipelines, and deployment on AWS or Azure.
faq2.q: Do you work in Paris or remotely?
faq2.a: I am based in the Paris region and work in Paris and its surroundings, on site or remotely. For projects outside the region, the work is done remotely with regular check-ins.
faq3.q: Can you take a project from end to end?
faq3.a: Yes, that is the core of my practice: design, API, interface, database, CI/CD pipeline, cloud deployment and monitoring. You have a single point of contact from scoping through to production.
faq4.q: Can you take over an existing application?
faq4.a: Yes. I have delivered handovers of existing codebases, data migrations onto new schemas and CI/CD setups on applications already in service, with cut-over and no downtime.
faq5.a: Four years as an employed developer at Olinn and then G-ON, on business applications and cloud delivery pipelines, alongside Consaltia.
